artDirection: Pristine contemporary pop studio. Factory-new crystal-clear acrylic jewel case, polished cold chrome, pearlescent stage, controlled iridescent highlights. Clean glass-panel intro. No distressed paper, aged tint, tape, scratches, dust or film grain. Natural textured adult artist skin.
